title: When Did Marriage Become So Hard?

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: No matter how many you've been to,
sentences.zh: 无论你参加过多少场婚礼，

sentences.en: it's hard to shake the contagious optimism of weddings.
sentences.zh: 都很难摆脱婚礼上那种极具感染力的乐观氛围。

sentences.en: Couples vow to love one another in sickness and in health,
sentences.zh: 夫妻誓言无论疾病还是健康都要彼此相爱，

sentences.en: for richer, for poorer.
sentences.zh: 无论贫穷还是富有。

sentences.en: Family members dab tears from their eyes,
sentences.zh: 家人们擦去眼角的泪水，

sentences.en: agreeing that these two people are meant to be together forever.
sentences.zh: 认同这两个人注定要永远在一起。

sentences.en: But so many marriages become unhappy.
sentences.zh: 但许多婚姻最终却变得并不幸福。

sentences.en: Some dissolve, some end in divorce.
sentences.zh: 有的分道扬镳，有的以离婚收场。

sentences.en: And even the successful ones aren't without challenges.
sentences.zh: 即便那些看似美满的婚姻，也并非没有挑战。

sentences.en: No one would deny that long-term relationships are hard.
sentences.zh: 没人会否认长期关系经营起来很难。

sentences.en: And in fact, there's evidence they're getting harder.
sentences.zh: 事实上，有证据表明这种难度正在增加。

sentences.en: Why is that?
sentences.zh: 这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we'll take a closer look at the history of marriage.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Hidden Brain》节目，我们将深入探究婚姻的历史。

sentences.en: Most of what we think of as traditional marriage was not traditional at all, but a rather recent invention.
sentences.zh: 我们所认为的传统婚姻，其实大多根本不是什么传统，而是一个相当近代的发明。

sentences.en: We'll also explore the radically higher expectations we have for marriage today.
sentences.zh: 我们还将探讨当今人们对婚姻极高的期望。

sentences.en: Lots of people argue that having these high expectations is problematic and it's harming the institution of marriage.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为，抱有如此高的期望是有问题的，这正在损害婚姻制度。

sentences.en: And frankly, among the people who used to argue that is myself.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，曾经持这种观点的人里就包括我。

sentences.en: And we'll discuss ways to improve our love lives, sometimes by asking more of our partners and of ourselves, sometimes by asking less.
sentences.zh: 我们将探讨改善爱情生活的方法，有时是通过对伴侣和自己提出更多要求，有时则是通过减少要求。

sentences.en: To understand marriage today, we thought it best to go back to a time and place when marriage was very different.
sentences.zh: 为了理解当今的婚姻，我们认为最好回到一个婚姻形式截然不同的时代和地点去看看。

sentences.en: Well, I've been studying the history of family life for many, many years.
sentences.zh: 我研究家庭生活史已经很多很多年了。

sentences.en: But I specifically got interested in marriage as we got into these debates about what traditional marriage was.
sentences.zh: 但当我开始关注关于“传统婚姻”是什么的争论时，我才对婚姻产生了特别的兴趣。

sentences.en: That's Stephanie Kuhns.
sentences.zh: 那是斯蒂芬妮·库恩茨。

sentences.en: She's a professor at the Evergreen State College and the author of the book Marriage, A History.
sentences.zh: 她是常青州立学院的教授，也是《婚姻的历史》一书的作者。

sentences.en: Stephanie says the earliest marriages had nothing to do with the feelings of two people or their attraction to one another.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮说，最早的婚姻与两个人的感情或彼此的吸引力毫无关系。

sentences.en: As you probably know, marriage was much more about economics and acquiring powerful in-laws.
sentences.zh: 正如你可能知道的那样，婚姻更多是关于经济利益和获得有权势的姻亲。

sentences.en: Marriage originally arose in more egalitarian band level societies as a way of sharing resources
sentences.zh: 婚姻最初出现在更平等的部落社会中，作为一种分享资源的方式，

sentences.en: and establishing peaceful relations with groups that you might otherwise only see occasionally
sentences.zh: 并与那些你可能只会偶尔见到的人群建立和平关系，

sentences.en: and you might not know if they were going to be friends or enemies.
sentences.zh: 而你可能无法确定他们究竟会是朋友还是敌人。

sentences.en: It was a way of circulating obligations and goods.
sentences.zh: 这是一种流通义务和商品的方式。

sentences.en: I marry my child off to you, and that means you owe me things, but I also owe you things.
sentences.zh: 我把孩子嫁给你，这意味着你欠我人情，但我同时也欠你人情。

sentences.en: Stephanie brought up a famous example from history.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮提到了历史上一个著名的例子。

sentences.en: The union between Cleopatra of Egypt and Mark Antony of Rome.
sentences.zh: 埃及艳后克利奥帕特拉与罗马马克·安东尼之间的结合。

sentences.en: Elizabeth Taylor as Cleopatra, siren of the Nile.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·泰勒饰演克利奥帕特拉，尼罗河的妖女。

sentences.en: This is from a 1963 film version.
sentences.zh: 这是1963年电影版中的片段。

sentences.en: Richard Burton as Mark Antony, rash, impetuous leader of once invincible legion,
sentences.zh: 理查德·伯顿饰演马克·安东尼，那支曾经不可战胜的军团中鲁莽、冲动的领袖，

sentences.en: dreaded adversary on the field of battle.
sentences.zh: 战场上令人畏惧的对手。

sentences.en: The Hollywood version of the story portrays Cleopatra and Antony as being very much in love.
sentences.zh: 好莱坞版本的电影将克利奥帕特拉和安东尼描绘成一对深陷爱河的情侣。

sentences.en: But Stephanie paints a slightly different picture.
sentences.zh: 但斯蒂芬妮描绘的情况却略有不同。

sentences.en: I think that the theme song for that relationship could have been What's Love Got to Do With It.
sentences.zh: 我认为这段关系的定情曲应该是《爱与此何干》。

sentences.en: There may have been passion, but it was more passion for power than sexual,
sentences.zh: 他们之间或许有过激情，但那更多是对权力的渴望，而非肉体之欲，

sentences.en: although sexual probably entered into it too.
sentences.zh: 尽管肉体之欲可能也掺杂其中。

sentences.en: Cleopatra and Antony's marriage was primarily about strategy.
sentences.zh: 克利奥帕特拉和安东尼的婚姻主要出于战略考量。

sentences.en: Rome and Egypt were the two most powerful empires in the world.
sentences.zh: 罗马和埃及是当时世界上最强大的两个帝国。

sentences.en: So getting them, anybody who got them together and got an alliance between them would be unstoppable.
sentences.zh: 因此，无论谁能将这两个帝国联合起来，达成联盟，都将势不可挡。

sentences.en: The story goes that Cleopatra was married to her brother, and without getting into all the details, let's just say she wasn't too happy with that.
sentences.zh: 故事流传克利奥帕特拉曾嫁给自己的兄弟，细节就不多说了，只能说她对此并不怎么开心。

sentences.en: So she started an affair with Julius Caesar, the ruler of Rome.
sentences.zh: 于是她开始与罗马统治者尤利乌斯·凯撒私通。

sentences.en: Cleopatra became pregnant.
sentences.zh: 克利奥帕特拉怀孕了。

sentences.en: When the baby was born, he was named Caesarian.
sentences.zh: 孩子出生后，被取名为凯撒里昂。

sentences.en: The child gave Cleopatra and Caesar a claim to each other's throne.
sentences.zh: 这个孩子让克利奥帕特拉和凯撒都有了觊觎对方王位的筹码。

sentences.en: It was something they both desperately wanted.
sentences.zh: 这正是他们两人都梦寐以求的东西。

sentences.en: Sounds like an episode of Game of Thrones, right?
sentences.zh: 听起来就像《权力的游戏》里的情节，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, then Caesar died, and Mark Anthony came along.
sentences.zh: 后来凯撒去世了，马克·安东尼出现了。

sentences.en: And, of course, the story tells that she seduced him.
sentences.zh: 当然，故事里说她诱惑了安东尼。

sentences.en: But, you know, when you really look at what was happening practically,
sentences.zh: 但你知道，当你真正审视当时发生的实际情况时，

sentences.en: this was another political alliance.
sentences.zh: 这又是另一场政治联姻。

sentences.en: First, as did Caesar, you will marry me according to Egyptian ritual.
sentences.zh: 首先，就像凯撒那样，你必须按照埃及的仪式娶我。

sentences.en: It's not a condition, it's a reward.
sentences.zh: 这不是条件，这是奖赏。

sentences.en: You will declare by your authority Caesarian to be king of Egypt,
sentences.zh: 你将以你的权威宣布凯撒里昂为埃及国王，

sentences.en: and we will rule together in his name.
sentences.zh: 我们将以他的名义共同统治。

sentences.en: Caesarian was too young to rule, and Anthony could rule in his place.
sentences.zh: 凯撒里昂当时太小无法执政，安东尼可以代他统治。

sentences.en: So it was a great big political alliance, just like Game of Thrones.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像《权力的游戏》一样，是一场宏大的政治联盟。

sentences.en: This marriage strategy wasn't just for kings and queens.
sentences.zh: 这种婚姻策略并非只适用于国王和王后。

sentences.en: There's a common misconception that people of lower classes in this time married for love.
sentences.zh: 有一种常见的误解，认为那个时代的底层民众是因爱结婚的。

sentences.en: Not true, Stephanie says.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮说，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: You couldn't run a farm with one person.
sentences.zh: 一个人是经营不了一座农场的。

sentences.en: You couldn't run a bakery with one person.
sentences.zh: 一个人也经营不了一家面包店。

sentences.en: So people who were bakers married other bakers.
sentences.zh: 所以面包师通常会嫁娶其他面包师。

sentences.en: If you were a peasant, you wanted somebody who had a good reputation as a hard worker.
sentences.zh: 如果你是农民，你会想要一个以勤劳著称的人。

sentences.en: And that was much more important than this frivolous luxury is the way it was really thought of as how attracted you were to the person.
sentences.zh: 这远比那种被视为轻浮奢侈的所谓“互相吸引”要重要得多。

sentences.en: A different idea started to become more common in the 17 and 1800s.
sentences.zh: 一种不同的观念在17和18世纪开始变得普遍。

sentences.en: Jane Austen, the famous novelist, may well have been the trailblazer.
sentences.zh: 著名小说家简·奥斯汀很可能就是这一观念的先驱。

sentences.en: For those who don't remember the plot of her book, Pride and Prejudice,
sentences.zh: 对于那些不记得她的小说《傲慢与偏见》情节的人来说，

sentences.en: Mr. Darcy, who has been promised in marriage to his wealthy cousin,
sentences.zh: 达西先生，他本已许配给富有的表亲，

sentences.en: falls instead for Elizabeth Bennet, a woman of modest means.
sentences.zh: 却爱上了一位家境平平的女子，伊丽莎白·班内特。

sentences.en: That throws his aunt into a rage.
sentences.zh: 这让他的姨妈勃然大怒。

sentences.en: Mr. Darcy is engaged to my daughter.
sentences.zh: 达西先生已经和我女儿订婚了。

sentences.en: Now what have you to say?
sentences.zh: 你现在还有什么话说？

sentences.en: Only this, if that is the case,
sentences.zh: 只有一句，如果真是那样的话，

sentences.en: you can have no reason to suppose he would make an offer to me.
sentences.zh: 你没有任何理由认为他会向我求婚。

sentences.en: You selfish girl!
sentences.zh: 你这个自私的女孩！

sentences.en: This union has been planned since their infancy.
sentences.zh: 这桩婚事在他们幼年时就定下了。

sentences.en: Do you think it can be prevented by a young woman of inferior birth?
sentences.zh: 你以为凭一个出身低微的年轻女子就能阻挠吗？

sentences.en: Heaven and earth.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Are the shades of Pemberley to be thus polluted?
sentences.zh: 彭伯里的名声难道要因此蒙羞吗？

sentences.en: Now tell me once and for all, are you engaged to him?
sentences.zh: 现在给我一个准话，你和他订婚了吗？

sentences.en: I am not.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: So, Stephanie, talk about this.
sentences.zh: 那么，斯蒂芬妮，谈谈这个吧。

sentences.en: This is the first glimmers, if you will,
sentences.zh: 这可以说是最初的萌芽，

sentences.en: of the idea that in some ways love was coming to conquer marriage.
sentences.zh: 即爱情在某种程度上开始征服婚姻的观念。

sentences.en: This clip you used is perfect because it illustrates the fact that
sentences.zh: 你用的这段视频非常完美，因为它说明了一个事实：

sentences.en: men found it easier to embrace the love match than women did.
sentences.zh: 男性比女性更容易接受因爱结合。

sentences.en: Men could marry down because they could go out and earn wages.
sentences.zh: 男性可以向下通婚，因为他们可以外出挣钱。

sentences.en: Women had to be very, very cautious.
sentences.zh: 女性则必须非常、非常谨慎。

sentences.en: You know, as you could say, my heart inclines to Harry,
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像你可以说的那样，我的心倾向于哈里，

sentences.en: but, you know, I'd better marry who my parents want me to
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我最好还是嫁给父母希望我嫁的人，

sentences.en: and the person who is most likely to be able to support me.
sentences.zh: 以及最有可能养活我的人。

sentences.en: And so there was a long period of time where men actually were more romantic than women in the courtship arena.
sentences.zh: 因此，在求偶领域，曾有很长一段时间男性实际上比女性更浪漫。

sentences.en: By the second half of the 19th century, the Jane Austen model of marriage had taken firm hold
sentences.zh: 到了19世纪下半叶，简·奥斯汀式的婚姻观在美国已经根深蒂固。

sentences.en: in the United States.
sentences.zh: 在美国。

sentences.en: The idea of marrying for anything other than love came to be seen as
sentences.zh: 为了爱情以外的任何理由而结婚的想法，开始被视为

sentences.en: old-fashioned.
sentences.zh: 过时了。

sentences.en: And with the rise of this new idea came another.
sentences.zh: 随着这一新观念的兴起，又出现了另一种观念。

sentences.en: If marriage was once seen as a
sentences.zh: 如果说婚姻曾经被视为

sentences.en: partnership between people from similar backgrounds and similar social classes,
sentences.zh: 背景相似、社会阶层相当的人之间的伙伴关系，

sentences.en: the new model of marriage began to celebrate the coming together of people who were supposedly
sentences.zh: 那么新的婚姻模式开始推崇那些被认为

sentences.en: radically different from one another.
sentences.zh: 截然不同的人走到一起。

sentences.en: And you got this new theory that love was
sentences.zh: 于是出现了一种新理论，认为爱情是

sentences.en: a union of opposites.
sentences.zh: 对立面的结合。

sentences.en: Now this idea came that men and women were totally different and you could
sentences.zh: 现在出现了一种观点，认为男女完全不同，你只有通过结婚并

sentences.en: only have access to the emotions, resources, abilities of the other by getting married and
sentences.zh: 维持婚姻，才能获得对方的情感、资源和能力。

sentences.en: staying married.
sentences.zh: 维持婚姻。

sentences.en: You were incomplete without it.
sentences.zh: 没有婚姻，你就是不完整的。

sentences.en: In practice, this dovetailed with a changing
sentences.zh: 在实践中，这与当时国家不断变化的

sentences.en: economic landscape in the country where men increasingly became the breadwinners and women
sentences.zh: 经济格局相吻合，男性日益成为养家糊口的人，而女性

sentences.en: became homemakers.
sentences.zh: 则成为了家庭主妇。

sentences.en: The 1950s sitcom, Leave it to Beaver, makes clear this division between male and female
sentences.zh: 20世纪50年代的情景喜剧《留给海狸》清楚地展示了这种男女

sentences.en: roles.
sentences.zh: 角色的分工。

sentences.en: Whenever we cook inside, mom always does the cooking.
sentences.zh: 每当我们在室内做饭时，妈妈总是负责烹饪。

sentences.en: Whenever we cook outside, you always do it.
sentences.zh: 每当我们在户外做饭时，你总是负责。

sentences.en: How come?
sentences.zh: 这是为什么？

sentences.en: Well, it's sort of traditional, I guess.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想这算是一种传统吧。

sentences.en: You know, they say a woman's place is in the home, and I suppose as long as she's
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们常说女性的归宿在家庭，我想只要她

sentences.en: in the home, she might as well be in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 在家里，她最好还是待在厨房里。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: Well, that explains about mom.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那解释了妈妈的情况。

sentences.en: But how come you always do the outside cooking?
sentences.zh: 但为什么你总是负责户外烹饪呢？

sentences.en: Well, I'll tell you, son.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我告诉你吧，孩子。

sentences.en: Women do all right when they have all the modern conveniences.
sentences.zh: 女性在拥有所有现代便利设施时做得很好。

sentences.en: But us men are better at this rugged type of outdoor cooking.
sentences.zh: 但我们男人更擅长这种粗犷的户外烹饪。

sentences.en: Sort of a throwback to caveman days.
sentences.zh: 算是回归原始人的生活方式吧。

sentences.en: Talk to me about this idea, Stephanie.
sentences.zh: 跟我谈谈这个想法，斯蒂芬妮。

sentences.en: So clearly, gender biases played a role in how we came to think about marriage.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，性别偏见在我们对婚姻的思考方式中发挥了作用。

sentences.en: Well, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 嗯，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: But what's interesting about this clip is that the concept of the male breadwinner
sentences.zh: 但这段视频有趣的地方在于，男性作为养家糊口者的概念

sentences.en: was unknown before the 19th century.
sentences.zh: 在19世纪之前是闻所未闻的。

sentences.en: Women worked in the home, but so did men.
sentences.zh: 女性在家里工作，男性也一样。

sentences.en: And men didn't go out and bring home the bacon.
sentences.zh: 而且男人并不是出去赚钱养家。

sentences.en: Women helped raise the pig.
sentences.zh: 女性也帮忙养猪。

sentences.en: Maybe the man butchered it,
sentences.zh: 也许男人负责宰杀，

sentences.en: but the woman often cured the bacon
sentences.zh: 但女人通常负责腌制培根，

sentences.en: and took the bacon to market.
sentences.zh: 并把培根拿到市场上去卖。

sentences.en: So again, this was part of this new idea of love
sentences.zh: 所以再说一次，这是我之前提到的那种新爱情观的一部分。

sentences.en: that I talked about earlier.
sentences.zh: 我之前提到的。

sentences.en: The idea that men and women were so different
sentences.zh: 那种认为男女差异巨大，

sentences.en: that the man had to do all the outside stuff
sentences.zh: 以至于男人必须做所有户外事务，

sentences.en: because the woman couldn't do it,
sentences.zh: 因为女人做不了，

sentences.en: and the woman had to do all the inside stuff
sentences.zh: 而女人必须做所有室内事务，

sentences.en: because the man couldn't do it and wasn't supposed to do it.
sentences.zh: 因为男人做不了，也不应该做。

sentences.en: The idea of the love match may have been controversial at first,
sentences.zh: “因爱结合”的理念起初或许颇具争议，

sentences.en: but when concerns were raised about how people from different backgrounds would stay together
sentences.zh: 但当人们开始担心来自不同背景的人如何维持关系，

sentences.en: when they didn't have the bond of shared work or the larger framework of a shared community,
sentences.zh: 尤其是在没有共同工作或更广泛的社区框架作为纽带时，

sentences.en: advocates for love marriage said men and women would stay together
sentences.zh: 婚姻自主的倡导者们表示，男女双方之所以能维持关系，

sentences.en: because they needed one another to feel psychologically complete.
sentences.zh: 是因为他们需要彼此来获得心理上的完整感。

sentences.en: This theory was later appropriated in romantic stories and movies.
sentences.zh: 这一理论后来被浪漫故事和电影所采纳。

sentences.en: Think of the saying, opposites attract.
sentences.zh: 想想那句老话：异性相吸。
